title: Below Is Part of a Business Report
passage:
Recently, we've had many hungry customers walking in at lunchtime on weekdays. A new office building has opened down the street, and we've become the top choice for workers to host business partners for lunch. What we earn from our weekday lunchtime customers now makes up just over half of our total income.

But right now, we aren't employing enough workers to handle it. We need an extra waitress or two for the busy lunch hour. The problem is that after lunch, we have a long quiet period when there's almost no useful activities for workers to do. And, of course, it's hard to hire anyone who will be available for just one hour.

Therefore, we may need to make the business more active in the afternoon to solve the problem. Students return in the fall, so we could introduce a student club with cheaper meals between 1:30 and 5:30 p.m. If that works, we can start interviewing new waitresses. Another option is to close between 1:30 and 5:30 p.m. We have some big decisions to make, and I'll call a meeting soon to discuss everything.
